paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the generation length comparison between Vanilla CoT and TLDR (Ours) across four benchmark datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B model. The horizontal axis lists the categories, while the vertical axis represents the generation length in words, ranging from 0 to 8000 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 1000. For each dataset, two bars are presented: a light red bar for Vanilla CoT and a dark red bar for TLDR (Ours). The generation lengths for Vanilla CoT are approximately 554, 2861, 6820, and 4510 words for GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, respectively, while for TLDR (Ours), the lengths are around 254, 1547, 6343, and 3380 words. The bars are grouped by dataset, with percentage changes annotated above the TLDR bars, showing reductions of -54%, -46%, -7%, and -25% for GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and the TLDR bars are visually distinct due to their darker color, but no additional emphasis is observed.
